referee_caveats_inferred: Continuum RMS is 4x above theoretical and dynamic range limited by the bright source, which affects faint source and polarization fraction detections
DCF applied with a single assumed xi and no Monte Carlo uncertainty; B_pos errors only loosely quantified
Summary says the 6.1 mG value is at the central source, while the filament table assigns 5.2-6.1 mG to the West region
Temperatures of 13-16 K from a marginally optically thick line peak conflict with 50-150 K assumed for compact sources, and the 220 Msun envelope mass is sensitive to that choice
Polarization calibration and polarization thresholds are not described

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: About 10-30 GB for a single 12 m execution block (45 min on source, five SPWs, full polarization) in the archive; reproduction needs the raw MS plus calibration scripts
reproducibility.score_reason: Project code and main settings (SPWs, beam, RMS, self-cal intervals, CASA version) are given and numeric results are listed, but polarization calibration, tclean parameters and region definitions are missing and the paper does not state data availability.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The recipe lacks polarization calibration and imaging parameters and the paper does not state that the data are public, so the main numbers cannot be redone from the text alone.
